newsitem.title: USA: Group agrees to sell 7.5 pct Banyan stake.
newsitem.headline: Group agrees to sell 7.5 pct Banyan stake.

text.p: A group including Gabriel Capital and Ariel Management Corp said Wednesday it agreed to sell its 7.5 percent stake in Banyan Mortgage Investment Fund to RGI U.S. Holdings Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said the sale follows a Dec 3 stock purchase agreement with RGI. The closing is expected on Dec 6.
In April Banyan had agreed to merge with RGI U.S. Holdings, a wholly-owned subsidiary of RGI Holdings Inc, subject to stockholder approval.
The group controls 3,561,000 common shares or 7.5 percent of Banyan's outstanding class.

In November, Banyan received an unsolicited proposal from Apollo Real Estate Advisors II LP for $0.46875 per share. Banyan said on Tuesday said it received an unsolictied bid from Andrew Beal, the principal stockholder of Beal Financial Corp for $0.51 per share.
